resources.name: ImpactHK 29 Community Centre
resources.address: G/F, Cherry Mansion, 29 Oak Street, Tai Kok Tsui, Kowloon, Hong Kong
resources.summary: A daily community centre for people experiencing homelessness, with meals, clothing, toiletries, sleeping bags, laundry, haircuts, charging, and internet.
resources.availabilityNote: Open daily according to the official center page. Specific items and support depend on current supply and program schedules.
resources.sourceDetail: ImpactHK's official centre page lists the address, daily opening, meals, resource bank, laundry, and practical support.

resources.name: Hong Kong Short-term Food Assistance
resources.address: Service teams covering districts across Hong Kong
resources.summary: Government-funded nonprofit teams provide short-term basic food assistance to people and families facing immediate financial difficulty.
resources.availabilityNote: Applicants must contact the team serving their district and provide the requested identity, address, and financial information.
resources.sourceDetail: The department publishes program rules, free-cost status, eligibility, and current service-unit contacts.
resources.coverageNote: District-based service teams across Hong Kong.
